description: Schedule SE is per person: on a joint return the SE earner has no W-2 while the spouse earned $100,000 (box 3 $100,000). With socialSecurityWagesProvided true and socialSecurityWages 0, line 8a is $0 and the full OASDI base applies: 50,000 x 92.35% = 46,175; line 10 = 46,175 x 12.4% = 5,725.70 -> $5,726; line 11 = 46,175 x 2.9% = 1,339.075 -> $1,339; line 12 = $7,065. Before the flag, a $0 fell through to the couple's $100,000 of wages and understated OASDI.
